reference.hertz: Hertz 1882 J. reine angew. Math. 92:156; Johnson 1985 Contact Mechanics Sec. 4.2 DOI:10.1017/cbo9781139171731; Boussinesq 1885 (point load kernel)
reference.exact_deflection: w(r) = (1/(pi E*)) int_0^a p(s) s 4K(m)/(r+s) ds, m = 4rs/(r+s)^2 (Boussinesq kernel superposition)

criteria.reference: Hertz 1882 J. reine angew. Math. 92:156; Johnson 1985 Contact Mechanics Sec. 4.2 DOI:10.1017/cbo9781139171731; Boussinesq 1885 (point load kernel)
criteria.pool_mandate: <3% on contact radius a and indentation delta, load P prescribed

diagnostics.hypothesis: the 0.2-0.3% (of delta) field-shape residual against the analytic Hertz profile comes from the discrete contact traction rather than from the elastic operator
diagnostics.test: feed the traction the FE solution recovered into the exact half-space kernel and compare its field with the FE field
diagnostics.reading: the FE displacement field is *closer* to the exact Hertz field than to the exact response of its own recovered traction: the post-processed pressure field, not the displacement field, carries the larger error (consistent with the displacement being the variationally optimal quantity).  The 0.2-0.3% residual therefore remains unattributed to either the operator or the traction, and is reported as an open record.

gate_table.quantity: |w(0)/delta - 1| of the exact half-space oracle (no FEM)
gate_table.reference: Hertz relation w(0) = pi p0 a/(2 E*) = a^2/R = delta

gate_table.quantity: max |w(r) - (delta - r^2/2R)|/delta of the oracle for r/a < 1
gate_table.reference: the indenter is a paraboloid: the exact solution is flat inside contact
Boussinesq point-load asymptote of the same Hertz pressure

gate_table.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact| / delta over r/a in [1.1, 3], h/a=0.015, depth 96a
gate_table.reference: exact half-space deflection under the Hertz pressure; D = w(r)-w(0)
gate_table.note: offset invariant: the fixed base of the truncated body leaves an arbitrary rigid constant in the raw nodal u_z

gate_table.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact| / |D_exact| over the same radii
gate_table.reference: same, normalised by the local deflection

gate_table.quantity: |max shape error (h/a=fine) - max shape error (h/a=coarse)| (pct points)
gate_table.reference: a field metric that is real should not move under refinement by 2
the raw constant is truncation: it must move when the boundary moves
gate_table.note: the offset is discarded by the field metric, so the field verdict does not depend on it

gate_table.quantity: max penetration / delta of the finest mesh
gate_table.reference: ALM complementarity: the indenter must not penetrate

gate_table.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact(p_fe)| / delta over the observation radii, where p_fe is the traction the FE solution itself recovered
gate_table.reference: exact half-space response to the FE traction (same Boussinesq kernel)
gate_table.note: loose consistency bound on the (pressure recovery + elastic operator) pair; see the diagnostics block for what this does NOT show

gate_table.quantity: max shape error (pct of delta) of the same metric evaluated against a wrong competing Hertz state with a 10% larger contact radius
gate_table.reference: same load, a' = 1.1a, p0' = p0/1.21, delta' = 1.21 delta
gate_table.note: non-vacuity control: a tolerance the metric cannot enforce is worthless

gate_table.quantity: |indentation error here - indentation error of the certified load-control anchor| (pct points), same mesh and load
gate_table.note: replication check: this driver must reproduce the certified number
